## Download and use this snapshot

This page describes the published files in `nicktempleman/csoai-gspc-verify`. Treat them as a dated snapshot: use the observation dates and limitations in the files and source notes below. A page edit does not refresh the measurements.

With the Kaggle CLI installed and authenticated:

```bash
kaggle datasets download -d nicktempleman/csoai-gspc-verify -p ./dataset --unzip
```

Start by inspecting `pointers.jsonl`. Keep its original bytes and record the Kaggle version before transforming or comparing results.

Published files include:

- `README.md`
- `eval.yaml`
- `manifest.jsonl`
- `pointers.jsonl`

[Current GSPC board](https://councilof.ai/api/gspc) · [Methodology](https://councilof.ai/methodology/) · [Verify supported signed records](https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify/) · [Corrections](https://councilof.ai/claim-maintenance)

Apply the licence shown on this dataset. Published by Council of AI — Council for the Safety of Artificial Intelligence, operated by CSOAI Ltd. Measurement is not certification; a mirror or package is not evidence of current board admission or benchmark leadership.

> **Mirror.** This is a copy of https://huggingface.co/datasets/csoai/gspc-verify at revision `5b3815aa19b5e585bc4b8a92dee9defeca47341e`, made 2026-10-25. The Hugging Face copy is the original; if the two differ, it wins.

# GSPC Verify

> **Start here — free verify:** [https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify/](https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify/) (or the free MCP tool `verify_card` at `https://councilof.ai/mcp`) · **Full catalog:** [https://councilof.ai/catalog.json](https://councilof.ai/catalog.json) · Methodology: [https://councilof.ai/methodology/](https://councilof.ai/methodology/) · Measurement, not certification.

[![GSPC](https://councilof.ai/api/badge)](https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify)

This dataset carries **inputs and pointers for verifying published GSPC evidence**. It is a reader surface, not a mill, ranking engine, or certificate. The live board remains the authority: [`GET https://councilof.ai/api/gspc`](https://councilof.ai/api/gspc).

**Lid:** read `totals.lid` from https://councilof.ai/api/gspc at viewing time (never typed on this card).

Do not freeze a MEASURED/UNMEASURED table here. Re-read the live endpoints; fetch failure is **UNCHECKABLE**, never zero. The verifier checks supplied evidence and signatures; it does not create a favourable result or turn absence into a pass.

- Verify a card — free: https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify
- Live board: https://councilof.ai/api/gspc
- How to verify by hand: https://councilof.ai/signed/HOW-TO-VERIFY.md
- Transparency root: https://councilof.ai/root.json
- DID document: https://csoai.org/.well-known/did.json
- Canonical GSPC Space: https://huggingface.co/spaces/csoai/gspc-board

Measurement, not certification. A rank is never sold.
